comments.awaiting: Waiting for approval to leave **{stage}**: {approvals}. The task moves on by itself once they are approved or waived.
comments.changes_deferred: **{by}** requested changes on **{approval}** while the agent is working. They reach it when this run ends.
comments.resume_failed:

{note}
comments.settled_advancing: Every approval is in: moving on to **{stage}**.

errors.import_ids: an imported approval needs its id and its task's id
errors.label_too_long: the approval's label is too long (max {max} characters)
errors.note_too_long: the note is too long (max {max} characters)
errors.reason_too_long: the reason is too long (max {max} characters)

events.reset_answered: {label} back to pending after the requested changes
events.reset_changed: {label} back to pending: the code changed after it was approved
events.reset_reentered: {label} back to pending: the task is back in its stage

log.ensure: open the stage's approvals for task {task}
log.gate: read the approvals that gate task {task}
log.kick_back_failed: send task {task} back after changes were requested: {err}
log.record_event: record an approval event for task {task}
log.reopen: reopen the approvals that asked task {task} for changes
log.reset: reset the approvals of task {task} after its run
log.sync_flags: take in the flags the previous release wrote ({step})
